governing_equation: d2v_dx2 = defect_length**2 * tie_layer_shear_modulus / (topcoat_modulus * topcoat_thickness * tie_layer_thickness) * v

parameters.name: defect_length
parameters.justification: Length of the modelled zone next to a free coating edge (cut, damage or end of a coating patch), normalized to [0,1]; the peak interfacial stress only depends on the transfer length 1/beta (~9 um for the design, ~1.4 um for a standard tie-coat) as long as the zone is several transfer lengths long, so 0.1 mm keeps the problem well resolved for the solvers without changing the peak.
